alternatives_rejected.why: Injected delay would not explain a CPU jump of z=54.7 (572.1%) (E1). Its own span self-time also rose 2.53x (E2), so the slowdown is in its own processing, not only the network path.

frontend latency-50 deviated much less (z=15.9) than recommendationservice latency-90 (z=162.5) (E1). Inbound calls to recommendationservice slowed 6.49x (E2), so frontend latency is a downstream effect.

proposed_fix.description: Relieve CPU pressure on recommendationservice. Find and stop the CPU-hogging process or recent change, then raise the CPU limit or scale out replicas. Confirm that latency-90 and CPU return to their baselines.
